label: End-of-episode (last ~7 trials) while committed to a2
explanation: Fires only in the last trials of an episode: 99% of its mass is at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80. Equivalently it fires only when the value head is low (value < 5.22 holds 100% of its mass), since value drops as the episode end nears. Within that period it is almost entirely a2-specific: 98% of mass is on trials where the agent chooses a2, mostly while S2 is good and the policy logit favours a2 (choice < -1.5). It fires at D1 and GO and is silent at D2 when S1 is reached. The only FUTURE variable in the predicate is action at D1/GO, which is the agent own upcoming choice and so legitimate. The observed-only version (value < 4.5) & (choice < -1.52) & (phase != D2) does about as well on dev (F1 0.47, mass recall 0.86). Magnitude rises with ep_trial across a window and peaks at D1 just after a reward following an a2 trial. Penalty input and D1 fixation errors have high rates but little mass. Precision is limited: many late-episode a2 steps stay inactive, so the gate is clearly a ramp toward episode end, conditioned on a2.
